title: Chapter 546
text:
The hatch of the Blacklight Stealth opened, and a black-clothed Han Xiao appeared in front of everyone. He was very far away, and he was as small as an ant, only a small black dot.

Han Xiao leaped into the air, and this small black dot rapidly landed in the center of the beast horde.

Boom!

In the next instant, a shockwave exploded in the center of the beast horde, and a large amount of muddy black soil was blasted into the air.

The dozens of beasts around the landing point were sent flying hundreds of meters away, crashing into the other beasts.

Peng peng peng …

The beasts fell to the ground one after another, rolling in the muddy water miserably.

The four mechanical wrists were pressed against each other, and the five fingers were spread open with the palms facing down. It was as though a metal flower had bloomed, and Han Xiao was standing on top of the flower.

A crater appeared on the ground, and Han Xiao's surroundings became an empty space.

The beasts roared at Han Xiao from all directions, and the breath they exhaled from their mouths and noses formed a cloud of white vapor in the storm. Their claws and hooves dug into the ground, but they did not dare to charge forward immediately, expressing their fear of this uninvited guest.

"It has only been a few minutes, and he came so quickly!"

"Indeed, there is a continuation of the storyline. Black Star is going to personally fight!"

The players were roused. Ever since Black Star had returned, the number of times he had acted could be counted on one hand. Just how strong was Black Star? This was the question in the hearts of the players. Many of them turned on the recording function and posted it on the forums, benefiting the masses.

The millions of Blue Star players who were unable to make it to the scene all watched the situation through the forums. Countless gazes were focused on Han Xiao, and they were filled with nervousness and anticipation.

"I've finally found you. You actually created a body … Hmm, why does it look so familiar?"

Han Xiao's gaze swept past the beasts and locked onto the Mutation Source. He sized it up, and a look of shock appeared on his face. He realized that the features of the Mutation Source were a little familiar, as though he had seen it somewhere before. After thinking for a while, his heart skipped a beat. This facial features, this eyebrows, this physique, why did it look a little like the leader of the Germinal Organization? It must be an illusion.

"I know you …" The Mutation Source slowly opened its mouth, and its tone was strange.

Controlling the infected was an instinct of the Mutation Source, and it was similar to how a normal person controlled their limbs. At this stage, the Mutation Source had a purpose in controlling the infected, and the surrounding beasts were its' army '. The Mutation Source had its own consciousness, and it shared the senses of the infected. Every infected person was its eyes and ears, and the refugees in the Sanctuary would often see Han Xiao. Thus, it was not strange for the Mutation Source to recognize him.

"Oh, you can even talk." Han Xiao was amused.

"A part of my senses … became dull … Did you do that? Why … do you want to hurt me? "

Godora's suppressive device took effect, and the condition of the infected in a large area was controlled. Just like how a person's limbs were numb, their senses were no longer as' nimble 'as before, becoming sluggish and hard to control.

In its mind, anyone who stole its senses was an enemy, but it had always felt wronged. It was very confused. It only lived according to its instincts and did not understand why others always wanted to hurt it.

Han Xiao's body flashed, and his fist smashed toward the head of the Mutation Source. He was not interested in answering the question. The Mutation Source had to be eliminated, and there was no need to talk nonsense.

At the moment of impact, the mechanical parts spread out along his arm, and his fist turned into an alloy fist that was over a meter in size. It was covered in blue lightning and contained a penetrating shockwave.

The force of the impact was immense, and the surface of the metal fist that came into contact with the Mutation Source's body exploded into a ring of water.

Bang!

The face of the Mutation Source was smashed into a flat surface, and it was like a baseball that had been hit by a home run.

"Roar!"

The moment the mission was triggered, the Mutation Source that was sent flying decisively added anger to the beasts. The eyes of the beasts became bloodshot, and they went berserk!

Making use of this short period of time, the enemy's information appeared on his interface. Han Xiao took a quick glance, and his eyes narrowed.

"The Mutation Source is only at the half-mature stage, and it is far from a complete body. Its attributes are completely suppressed by mine, and this is good news. However, this fellow is a special lifeform and has the template of a boss. Although it is only at level 75, its health has reached 12,000! Indeed, it has a few talents similar to the storyline in my previous life, and it is not easy to kill … "

[Super Cell Proliferation Control]: Uses energy to proliferate cells and recover damage. Energy is converted into health at a ratio of 1: 10. The highest recovery rate is 50% health/s.

[Efficient Energy Absorption]: When receiving physical, energy, or magic attacks, a portion of the damage will be converted into energy.

[Talent — Special Material Form]: Permanently reduces damage received by 75%.

These three talents were the abilities of the Mutation Source, and their effects were at the level of Molding Talents. They allowed the Mutation Source to possess an extremely tenacious vitality, and the damage caused by that punch had recovered in the blink of an eye. The first talent allowed the Mutation Source's recovery rate to be extremely shocking. As long as there was sufficient energy, it could recover 6,000 health per second!

As for the other two talents, they provided him with sufficient energy. For example, if an attack had a theoretical damage of 100 points, it would only deal 25 points of damage to the Mutation Source. Furthermore, the 75 points of theoretical damage would provide the Mutation Source with 75 points of energy. Energy was the lifeline of the Mutation Source.

If converted to health, the Mutation Source would be able to recover 750 health points after receiving 25 points of damage!

If not for the destructive injection developed by Godora, it would be extremely difficult to kill the Mutation Source unless the damage exceeded 6,000 points per second or if it was insta-killed.

Nagojin had said that the injection would be able to insta-kill the Mutation Source, but that was only the ideal situation of the research department. In reality, the Mutation Source could not be destroyed with just a single injection.

Han Xiao remembered the situation in his previous life. A single injection would reduce the maximum health of the Mutation Source by 25%, and the effects of the three Molding Talents would be reduced by half. This was equivalent to the Mutation Source becoming weaker. Using the 100 points of theoretical damage as an example, this time, it would cause 62.5 points of actual damage, which was equivalent to the Mutation Source recovering 187.5 health points. Furthermore, it could only recover 25% of its health every second.

If it was injected a second time, the Mutation Source would become even weaker. Only after three injections would the structure of the Mutation Source begin to crumble. In truth, Han Xiao felt that this was a problem with the dosage. However, it was a pity that there was only one battle, and there were no more chances to experiment.

Afterward, the Mutation Disaster became a dungeon that Godora gave out, and the injection was a necessary tool for the mission. The dosage was fixed, and the players were unable to modify it.

The injection in Han Xiao's hands was already sealed, and it was not easy to modify it.

When the Mutation Source was sent flying by Han Xiao's fist, the hundreds of players watching from afar suddenly triggered a Grade B mission on their interface — [Destroy the Source]!

This was a Boss mission that came with the Main Storyline Mission of the Mutation Disaster, and it was the Final Battle Mission. It had appeared more than a year earlier than the storyline in his previous life.

Han Xiao had also triggered this mission.

The basic reward for [Destroy the Source] was 80 experience, and the mission requirement was very simple. The more beasts one killed, the higher the mission rating would be, and one would be able to obtain additional rewards.

The mission introduction stated that killing the Mutation Source would allow one to obtain the highest possible rating, but it did not mention the corresponding rewards.

However, Han Xiao knew that because only one person could complete the mission, the rewards for the first kill were extremely generous. One of the rewards was to obtain two of the Mutation Source's abilities or talents.

During the Final Battle in his previous life, the guilds had schemed against each other on the battlefield to snatch the first kill. In the end, it was King Admiral from the Dynasty Guild who had snatched the first kill.

But now, Han Xiao could only apologize to King Admiral in his heart.
